program.title: CARL WEATHERS BLOCK
program.subtitle: 11-Week Mass + Strength Build — KB, Sandbag, Rings

0.goal: Active recovery. Let the nervous system reset. Connective tissue and lower back get a full break before the next block. Opt in to these sessions — skip any or all if you need full rest.

blocks.note: Everything light and easy. No grinding. Move well.
Focus on quality and range of motion. Nothing heavy.
Carries only. No pressing, no pulling, no loading the spine hard. Just move.

1.goal: Establish volume foundation. Dip belt introduced from day one. Sandbag at 100lbs across all movements. Learn to log dip and pull-up numbers every session.

blocks.note: Primary strength indicator. Log weight and reps every session. Dip belt weight in lbs.
This is the 150lb ramp. Non-negotiable form — no grinding reps. Drop the set if lower back talks.
Primary strength indicator. Mirror the dip belt progression from Day 1. Log every session. Dip belt weight in lbs.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

2.goal: Add one set to each primary block. Push rep quality and depth. Dip belt stays at 10lbs — own it before adding weight.

blocks.note: One more set than week 1. Log weight and reps.
Same load as week 1. Add one rep per set.
One more set than week 1. Log every session.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

3.goal: Sandbag jumps to 110lbs. Dip belt moves to 15lbs on both ring dips and pull-ups. KB clean + press — push to 20kg where form allows.

blocks.note: Dip belt jumps to 15lbs this week.
Attempt 20kg. Drop to 16kg if form breaks.
Sandbag moves to 110lbs. Back form is non-negotiable.
Dip belt jumps to 15lbs this week.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

4.goal: Consolidation week. Same load as week 3. Push rep quality and range of motion. Lower intensity on Day 2 by 20% — active recovery for the lower back before the strength bridge.

blocks.note: Same weight as week 3. Focus on depth and control.
Reduced volume this week — back check-in. Drop a set, keep the weight.
Carries only. No shouldering this week.
Same weight as week 3. Own every rep.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

5.goal: Sandbag to 120lbs. Dip belt moves to 20lbs. KB clean + press at 20kg as primary working weight. Volume stays high.

blocks.note: Dip belt moves to 20lbs.
20kg is now the working weight. 16kg only if form completely breaks.
Sandbag to 120lbs. Reset reps to 3 and rebuild.
Dip belt moves to 20lbs.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

6.goal: Volume peak week. Highest set counts of the entire block. Push top sets on ring dips and pull-ups. Sandbag holds at 120lbs — add reps instead.

blocks.note: Volume peak. Push the top sets.
Add a rep per set. Form still non-negotiable.
Volume peak. Push the top sets.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

7.goal: Sandbag to 130lbs. Dip belt moves to 25lbs. KB clean + press at 20kg is the primary — no dropping back unless injury risk.

blocks.note: Dip belt moves to 25lbs.
Sandbag to 130lbs. Reset reps to 3 and rebuild.
Dip belt moves to 25lbs.
EMOM — odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

8.goal: Deload week. Reduce sets by 30%. Keep all weights exactly the same. Lower back check-in. Do not skip this week — the next two weeks require full recovery.

blocks.note: Deload — sets reduced. Keep weight identical to week 7.
Deload — three sets only. Back check-in. If anything feels off, drop to carries only.
Deload — sets reduced. Keep weight identical to week 7.
EMOM — cut to 8 rounds for deload. Odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

9.goal: Sandbag to 140lbs. Dip belt moves to 30lbs. Snatch EMOM density increases. This is where the look starts coming together.

blocks.note: Dip belt moves to 30lbs. This is a meaningful jump — own every rep.
Sandbag to 140lbs. Reset reps to 3. You are two weeks from 150.
Dip belt moves to 30lbs.
EMOM density increase — 14 rounds. Odd minutes work, even minutes rest.

10.goal: 150lbs on the sandbag across all movements. Dip belt at 30lbs — hold and demonstrate the build. This is the week you prove the block worked.

blocks.note: Same dip belt as week 9. Max quality. You've earned this weight.
150lbs. This is the target you set at the start. Clean form only — no ego reps.
Same dip belt as week 9. Own every rep.
EMOM — 14 rounds. Odd minutes work, even minutes rest. Finish strong.
